english:
Missile, Rocket Launcher, or Grenade Launcher Kills grant 20% Area-of-Effect Damage Resistance and 60% Explosive Self-Damage Resistance for 15 seconds.

Qualifying missiles include:
• <yellow Quicksilver Storm />'s Rocket Tracer
• Nanotech Tracer Round
• Exhaustive Research Rockets
• Rocket Frames
• <yellow Grand Overture /> Missiles
• <yellow Hazardous Propulsion />'s Exodus Rockets

source.text:
2 Piece | Force Absorption

Upon scoring a Missile, Rocket Launcher or Grenade Launcher Kill:
20% Area-of-Effect Damage Resist and 60% Explosive Self-Damage Resist for 15 seconds.

Missiles:
Quicksilver Storm's Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Round, Exhaustive Research Rockets, Rocket Frames, Grand Overture Missiles, and Hazardous Propulsion's Exodus Rockets.
